title: Expose session-owned ACP stdio MCP tools through the guarded mission path
goal: Vision: V-6. Implement real Agent Client Protocol v1 client-supplied stdio MCP support with isolated session ownership, exact cwd/env, existing permission and spend controls, cancellation and real tool execution. This correctness work does not claim a source-size reduction or full protocol certification.

reuse.searched: Audited wire-client McpHost/DuplexStreams, CLI with_cli_host, tools authorized spawn/MAC/registry, core watched bus and parallel context, ACP executor/GAWD local runner, GEMI tool normalization and provider routes. Design receipts are private acp-mcp-design.json and acp-mcp-scope-plan.json. Reuse existing host and guarded mission paths; no external source or dependency.

coordination: protocol_audit owns ACP crate factory/lifecycle; scoped_tools owns core/tool overlay and worker carry; scoped_inference owns GEMI tool ownership and diagnostic routing. Parent integrator owns publication. No external Board posts or paid provider calls.
progress: ACP factory and explicit core/tool worker scope commits integrated privately; first actual root compile passed (cold52.79s, no qualification claim). Root owns process-contained MCP sessions with literal env/cwd and bounded I/O. Reuses harness process-group/Windows Job primitives. Managed I/O and real shipped-command E2E qualification in progress; inference companion completing all-session-schema availability and watched diagnostic routing.
